latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Free Product Video skill.
- Create 1080p MP4 product showcase videos from product photos (JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV, up to 200MB).
- AI-powered server-side video generation for e-commerce listings; typically completes in 30–60 seconds.
- Simple cloud API authentication: auto-obtains free credits for new users.
- Supports credits check, file upload, export, timeline edits, text overlays, and background music.
